title: meeting-recorder
subHeroTitle: Turn every meeting into structured knowledge and automated action
subHeroDesc: KeilHQ captures audio, transcribes dialogue with speaker identification, generates executive summaries, and proposes ready-to-approve tasks, CRM updates, and docs.

sections.title: Studio-grade audio recording and live voice visualizers
sections.desc: Record high-fidelity meeting audio straight from your browser with zero plugins. Features 5 real-time voice visualizers (Bar, Aura, Grid, Wave, Radial), in-flight controls, live timers, and instant cloud uploads.

gridItems.title: Instant Browser Recording
gridItems.desc: Record high-fidelity meeting audio straight from your browser with zero plugins or downloads required.

gridItems.title: Dynamic Voice Visualizers
gridItems.desc: Choose from 5 real-time visualizer themes (Bar, Aura, Grid, Wave, Radial) that dynamically pulse and respond to live voice audio.

gridItems.title: Full In-Flight Control
gridItems.desc: Manage recordings with a live elapsed timer, quick mute/unmute toggles, pause/resume controls, and one-click discard with instant cleanup.

gridItems.title: Instant Cloud Upload
gridItems.desc: Lightning-fast streaming direct to secure cloud storage for immediate AI processing and transcript generation.

sections.title: Speaker-diarized transcription and smart audio player
sections.desc: Distinguish turn-by-turn dialogue with automatic participant labels across global languages. Filter by speaker, search keywords in-transcript, and control playback with variable speeds and waveform scrubbing.

gridItems.title: Speaker Identification (Diarization)
gridItems.desc: Automatically distinguishes between different speakers, tagging turn-by-turn dialogue with distinct participant labels.

gridItems.title: Multi-Language Support
gridItems.desc: High-accuracy transcription with automatic language detection supporting global languages and regional dialects.

gridItems.title: Interactive Speaker Filters & Search
gridItems.desc: Click any participant's name to isolate their dialogue snippets, or search key terms with highlighted in-transcript matches.

gridItems.title: Advanced Audio Player
gridItems.desc: Control listening with variable playback speeds (0.5x–2.0x), visual waveform scrubbers, ±10-second skips, and 1-click export.

sections.title: Automated AI executive summaries and structured notes
sections.desc: AI automatically transforms raw dialogue into executive-ready meeting notes—including executive summaries, topic breakdowns, bulleted decision logs, and unresolved risk alerts.

gridItems.title: Executive Summary
gridItems.desc: High-level overview of meeting purpose, main highlights, and key outcomes generated instantly.

gridItems.title: Key Discussion Topics
gridItems.desc: Categorized breakdown of main conversation points for rapid scannability and quick reference.

gridItems.title: Decisions Made & Risk Alerts
gridItems.desc: Bulleted log of agreed-upon decisions alongside flagged risks and unresolved open questions requiring follow-up.

gridItems.title: Smart Deduplication & Formatting
gridItems.desc: Intelligent processing ensures meetings are never redundantly analyzed, displaying formatted views with 1-click markdown export.

sections.title: Human-in-the-loop AI action extraction
sections.desc: AI continuously analyzes meeting dialogue to propose tasks, CRM edits, deal stage movements, and finance entries across 5 modules. Review certainty ratings, direct transcript quote evidence, and edit prior to approval.

gridItems.title: 5 Smart Workspace Action Types
gridItems.desc: Extracts Task Creations, Task Updates, CRM Contact Updates, CRM Pipeline Stage Movements, and Finance Ledger Entries automatically.

gridItems.title: AI Confidence & Transcript Evidence
gridItems.desc: Every proposal displays a clear certainty rating (0–100%) paired with the exact meeting transcript excerpt that triggered the proposal.

gridItems.title: Full Inline Editing & Control
gridItems.desc: Edit proposed task titles, assignees, priority levels, or financial figures prior to approving—you maintain 100% control.

gridItems.title: 1-Click Review & Duplicate Safeguards
gridItems.desc: Approve individual items, reject with feedback, or batch-process pending actions with built-in duplicate protection.

sections.title: 1-click save to Motion Docs and Notion 2-way sync
sections.desc: Convert meeting summaries into formatted block-based Motion documentation pages or sync meeting notes automatically into connected Notion workspaces for centralized team access.

gridItems.title: Save to Motion Docs
gridItems.desc: Instantly convert meeting summaries into formatted, block-based Motion documentation pages within your project space.

gridItems.title: Notion 2-Way Sync
gridItems.desc: Automatically syncs meeting notes into your connected Notion workspace for centralized team access and cross-platform search.

gridItems.title: Structured Knowledge Base
gridItems.desc: Organize meeting documentation under project subpages with rich tags, cover images, and collaborative comment threads.

gridItems.title: Universal Clipboard Copy
gridItems.desc: Copy clean formatted markdown or raw transcript files with a single click for external reports and client deliverables.

sections.title: Connected workspace and universal meeting history
sections.desc: Attach recordings to specific tasks or calendar events, access past recordings via the universal history drawer from anywhere in KeilHQ, and inspect approved meeting actions in the activity feed.

gridItems.title: Linked Workspace Meetings
gridItems.desc: Attach recordings directly to specific workspace tasks, project spaces, or scheduled calendar events.

gridItems.title: Universal History Drawer
gridItems.desc: Access and review past meeting recordings from anywhere in the app (Dashboard, Tasks, Calendar, or Docs).

gridItems.title: Activity Audit Stream
gridItems.desc: Full team visibility into all approved meeting actions, task creations, and CRM updates within your real-time activity feed.

gridItems.title: Privacy & Ownership Controls
gridItems.desc: Secure owner-only deletion and granular workspace access permissions to protect sensitive discussion audio.

sections.title: Autonomous meeting bots and natural language AI assistant
sections.desc: Schedule bots to join Zoom, Google Meet, or Teams video calls to record and transcribe hands-free. Capture phone calls and query your meeting history in natural language.

gridItems.title: Autonomous Meeting Bots
gridItems.desc: Schedule bots to join video call links (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams) to record and transcribe discussions hands-free.

gridItems.title: Phone Call Integration
gridItems.desc: Capture, transcribe, and extract actionable follow-ups directly from incoming and outgoing phone calls.

gridItems.title: Ask AI About Meetings
gridItems.desc: Query your meeting history in natural language using the built-in AI Assistant (e.g., 'What did we decide about the Q3 budget in yesterday's meeting?').

gridItems.title: Cross-Module Intelligence
gridItems.desc: Seamlessly link meeting insights with Tasks, Motion Pages, CRM pipelines, and Financial ledgers in real-time.

capabilitiesTitle: Total meeting intelligence. Instant action extraction.
capabilitiesDesc: Connect voice recording, speaker diarization, executive summaries, human-in-the-loop action proposals, and Notion sync in one unified platform.
checklistTitle: Turn every conversation into structured execution
checklistDesc: KeilHQ Meeting Intelligence eliminates manual note-taking and automates workspace actions with full human approval control.
checklistItems: Studio-Grade Audio Recording & Live Visualizers: High-fidelity browser recording with 5 real-time voice visualizer themes, live timer, and in-flight controls.,
Speaker-Diarized Transcription & Smart Player: Turn-by-turn speaker identification, multi-language support, speaker filters, and visual waveform player with variable playback speeds.,
Automated AI Executive Summaries: Structured executive notes including high-level summaries, categorized topics, bulleted decisions, and unresolved risk alerts.,
Human-in-the-Loop AI Action Extraction: Automatically proposes Tasks, Task Updates, CRM Edits, Pipeline Movements, and Finance Entries with confidence scores and quote evidence.,
1-Click Motion & Notion 2-Way Sync: Convert meeting summaries into block-based Motion docs or sync notes automatically into connected Notion workspaces.,
Connected Workspace & Universal History: Link recordings to calendar events, access past recordings via the universal history drawer, and audit actions in the activity feed.,
Autonomous Meeting Bots & AI Assistant: Dispatch video bots to Zoom/Meet/Teams, capture phone calls, and query past meeting history using natural language AI prompts.
